test_policy.notes: UMD is test-optional through the Spring and Fall 2027 application cycles; applicants indicate their test-optional status in the application.

requirements.supplemental_essays: One essay (650 words max) from UMD's list of prompts or a topic of your choice; plus activities list or resume.
requirements.notes: Apply via Common App or UMD's own ApplyWeb (same review). Two recommendations required: one school counselor and one teacher. Mid-year reports/first-quarter grades are not required unless requested at decision notification.

deadlines.label: Early Action (non-binding)
deadlines.notes: Priority for merit scholarships and special programs. Notification 'by Feb. 1'. The deadlines page marks Nov. 1 as the prior calendar year's date for the following fall, so for fall 2027 entry it is Nov 1, 2026.
Decision released 'by April 1'. Applications after Jan 20 are considered on a rolling, space-available basis.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required if English is not your native language, regardless of citizenship (or if you took ESL courses in high school). Waivers considered, e.g. 4 years at a US high school without ESL coursework, a US degree, or citizenship/schooling in listed English-speaking countries. Scores must be under 2 years old; TOEFL MyBest superscores not accepted.

english.notes: 0-120 scale; includes TOEFL iBT Home Edition.
Official IELTS and IELTS Indicator accepted.
PTE is not listed among accepted tests.

aid.notes: Institutional merit scholarships are open to US citizens and eligible non-citizens only; CDS H6 says no institutional scholarship or grant aid is available for nonresident undergraduates.

majors.notes: Limited Enrollment Program: applicants who select it are reviewed by the program; those not admitted to it are placed in Letters & Sciences and can apply later after gateway requirements.
Limited Enrollment Program with gateway requirements; non-admitted applicants go to Letters & Sciences.
Limited Enrollment Program with gateway requirements; non-admitted applicants go to Letters & Sciences.

sat.note: Send to 'University of Maryland, College Park'.

ielts.note: No numeric code; have the official report sent to the UMD Office of Undergraduate Admissions.

duolingo.note: No numeric code; send official results to UMD from your Duolingo account (page gives reporting code 5814 for test agencies in general).

pte.note: PTE is not an accepted test at UMD.

tier_notes.math_physics: Physics and mathematics are top-15 departments.
tier_notes.nursing: No nursing at College Park (University of Maryland nursing is in Baltimore).
